summary.key_theme: 近期 Tesla 交付數據優於預期與中國市場成長，但面臨歐洲 FSD 品牌監管壓力、Cybertruck 銷售目標未達標以及市場對毛利率的擔憂，多空因素交織。

bullish.title: Tesla Shares Surge: What's Driving the Latest Rally
bullish.reason: 優於預期的車輛交付數據直接推動股價上漲，顯示市場對其核心業務需求仍具信心。

bullish.title: Tesla China-Made EV Sales Rise 5% in September, Extending Growth Streak To 11 Months
bullish.reason: 在整體全球銷售放緩的背景下，中國市場連續 11 個月成長，展現了 Tesla 在關鍵市場的韌性。

bullish.title: Elon Musk Wants Tesla, SpaceX To Test 10 Chip Designs A Year At Terafab
bullish.reason: 馬斯克推動高頻率晶片設計測試，顯示公司在 AI 與自動駕駛硬體領域的積極擴張策略。

bullish.title: Dear Tesla Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for Oct. 12 — Tesla Cybercab heads to Paris
bullish.reason: Cybercab 的展示活動被視為公司解鎖未來成長潛力的關鍵，吸引投資人高度關注。

bullish.title: Tesla (TSLA) Gain More From Megachargers Or Tokenized Stock Trading?
bullish.reason: Megacharger 網路的擴張為重型電動卡車業務提供支持，有助於長期營收多元化。

bullish.title: Tesla rival appears to have a demand problem
bullish.reason: 競爭對手 Lucid 交付量未達標且面臨成本壓力，間接凸顯 Tesla 在電動車市場的相對優勢。

bearish.title: Tesla Drops 'Full Self-Driving' brand name in Europe after regulator pushback
bearish.reason: 因監管機構壓力被迫更名，可能影響歐洲市場對 FSD 產品的行銷與消費者認知，此為多篇報導之核心事件。

bearish.title: Elon Musk’s 250,000 Cybertruck Goal Falls Well Short: New Data Shows Only 13% of Goal Sold Annually
bearish.reason: Cybertruck 實際銷售量遠低於馬斯克設定的目標，引發市場對產能爬坡與市場需求的質疑。

bearish.title: Forget the Recent Delivery Beat: Here's the Key Number That Will Decide Investors' Reaction to Tesla's Earnings
bearish.reason: 分析師提醒投資人應關注毛利率，暗示交付量成長可能伴隨著利潤率壓縮的風險。

bearish.title: Gary Black Says Tesla Needs to Follow Apple’s Playbook: TSLA Has Been ‘Underinvested in Marketing Forever’
bearish.reason: 知名投資人 Gary Black 指出 Tesla 長期缺乏行銷投入，認為這將影響其在自動駕駛領域的競爭力。

bearish.title: EXCLUSIVE: Ross Gerber Says Tesla May Make Just ‘a Few Hundred’ Roadsters
bearish.reason: Roadster 的產量預期極低，顯示該產品對公司整體營收貢獻有限，且被視為行銷噱頭。

bearish.title: How GM is Secretly Winning the US EV Race
bearish.reason: 通用汽車 EV 銷售成長迅速，對 Tesla 在美國市場的龍頭地位構成潛在威脅。

neutral.title: SPCX, TSM, APLD, AMZN, TSLA: Why Retail Traders Couldn’t Take Their Eyes Off These Stocks Last Week
neutral.reason: 僅為散戶交易熱度觀察，未對公司基本面產生實質影響。

neutral.title: He borrowed more than $100,000 to buy Tesla stock—Here's why more investors are taking on debt
neutral.reason: 報導投資人槓桿操作行為，反映市場情緒但非公司營運消息。

neutral.title: It Now Takes $4.4B To Make the Forbes 400: See America's 10 Richest People
neutral.reason: 提及馬斯克財富排名，與公司營運無直接關聯。

neutral.title: This Week in TSLA: FSD's Europe Rebrand, Elon Musk Receives Medal From Trump and More
neutral.reason: 週報性質，彙整了已知的 FSD 更名與交付數據，無新資訊。

neutral.title: Tesla Renames Full Self-Driving Package to Assisted Driving Across Europe
neutral.reason: 重複報導 FSD 更名事件，內容與其他新聞重疊。

neutral.title: Tesla Drops “Full Self-Driving” in Europe, Where Its Revenue Fell 10% Last Year
neutral.reason: 重複報導 FSD 更名事件，並補充歐洲營收數據，影響力有限。

neutral.title: Tesla Drops 'Full Self-Driving' Name in Europe as Germany Backs Faster EU Approval
neutral.reason: 重複報導 FSD 更名事件，無額外重大影響。

neutral.title: Tesla Beat Delivery Estimates by 25,000 Vehicles. Here's Why the Stock Still Hasn't Broken Out.
neutral.reason: 分析交付數據為何未帶動股價突破，屬於市場觀點分析。
